title: Smiling Graduate & Bow Tie Man, Campus Hall - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A radiant young woman in a graduation cap, academic gown, pearl necklace, and floral corsage beams outdoors beside an older gentleman wearing thick-rimmed glasses and a bow tie, accompanied by another smiling woman. In the background stands a monumental university hall featuring Romanesque arches and decorative brickwork. The lower border is stamped with the photo processing date of February 1966, capturing a proud family milestone during a decade marked by the rapid growth of collegiate education in mid-20th-century America.
